**Title (English, from literature):** Evicting a nun

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Nikkaḍḍhana-sikkhāpada* ("Evicting a nun", Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 35) is a monastic disciplinary rule found in the Vinaya Piṭaka. According to the rule, a nun who assigns or gives a dwelling place to another nun and later drives her out or throws her out commits an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*). In modern examinations of monastic organization, this rule is noted as the bhikkhunī counterpart to Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 17, both of which penalize monastics who evict fellow community members from monastery lodgings [Wijayaratna 1990]. An English translation of the text is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
